subject: Clarify: training-on-customer-data opt-out + residency & logging
messages:
From: Danielle Cross <danielle.cross@fastpay.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from demo — confirmation on training opt-out?

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — the latency/cost profile looked promising for our batch reconciliation use case. Before we progress to a pilot, our security team asked for two concrete items: a written confirmation that FastPay data will not be used to train or improve models, and the exact data residency + logging retention policy for requests sent to Redwood in the pilot.

Can you confirm in writing that Redwood will not use any FastPay data for model training or evaluation, and that logs (both request and token traces) will be retained for no more than 30 days and stored only in US regions? We need this to clear our procurement flow.

If possible, please attach a short commitment we can keep with the SOW.

Appreciate it — Danielle
Danielle Cross
Senior Security & Privacy, FastPay
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Cross <danielle.cross@fastpay.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo — confirmation on training opt-out?

Hi Danielle — great to hear from you and glad the demo was helpful.

Short answer: yes — Redwood will not use FastPay production data to train or improve model weights for any hosted or customer-shared training workflows unless you explicitly opt in via a signed agreement. We can provide a one-page Data Privacy Commitment that we attach to the SOW.

Details and commitments we include in the attached PDF (Data_Privacy_Commitment.pdf):
- No model training: FastPay data will be excluded from any model tuning, fine-tuning, or training pipelines run by Redwood.
- Logging controls: request metadata and token-level logs are retained for 30 days by default; access to logs is restricted to service and customer success personnel and audited.
- Data residency: pilot data will be pinned to the US (us-east-1) for processing and storage; we will not replicate pilot data to other regions without written consent.
- KMS & encryption: customer data at rest is encrypted with CMK managed in your account or a Redwood-managed KMS per the enterprise agreement.

Next steps I recommend: 1) review the attached one-pager, 2) confirm the residency region and whether you need retention <30 days, 3) Jordan (cc'd) will follow up with a DocuSign link for a signature if you want the commitment attached to the SOW.

I attached the one-page commitment for review. Let us know any edits and we can fast-track a signed copy.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
(555) 555-0127

Attachments: Data_Privacy_Commitment.pdf (pdf)
From: Danielle Cross <danielle.cross@fastpay.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo — confirmation on training opt-out?

Thanks Mina — the one-pager looks good at a high level. A couple of clarifying asks from procurement/security before we sign:

- Can you explicitly state “no training” language references model weight updates and internal evaluation datasets derived from customer data? We need that spelled out for legal.
- For logging, we need confirmation that token-level prompts (full prompt text) will not be retained beyond 30 days and that there is an option to disable token logging entirely for the pilot.
- For residency: we want to confirm processing happens in us-east-1 and that backups or analytics pipelines will not copy raw customer inputs to other regions.

If you can provide those explicit lines and a signed PDF, we can get procurement to attach it to the SOW and move to purchase.

Thanks — Danielle
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Cross <danielle.cross@fastpay.io>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Follow-up from demo — confirmation on training opt-out?

Hi Danielle — Jordan here from Contracts & Security. Thanks for the clear asks; we updated the commitment and attached a signed copy for FastPay. Key language we added (excerpt):

- "No training or model improvement: Redwood Inference will not use FastPay customer data, including prompts, responses, or derived features, to train, fine-tune, validate, or evaluate machine learning models or to update model weights, unless FastPay provides express written consent via a signed amendment to the Agreement."
- "Token logging: By default, Redwood retains request and token-level logs for no more than 30 days. For the FastPay pilot, Redwood will disable token-level logging upon request; metadata required for billing and routing will still be retained subject to the 30-day window."
- "Data residency: All processing and storage of FastPay pilot data will be restricted to AWS us-east-1. Backups and analytics that include raw customer inputs will not be transferred to other regions without FastPay's prior written approval."

We've attached the signed Data Privacy Commitment (signed_privacy_commitment.pdf) and created a DocuSign envelope if you'd prefer an e-sign path: https://app.docusign.com/XYZ-Agreement-RDW-2027-347

If that reads OK, please reply with "Signed — FastPay" and we'll attach this to the SOW and proceed to provisioning.

Regards,
Jordan Blake
Contracts & Security, Redwood Inference
